title: Bangladesh’s President Resigns Amid Uncertainty Over Ex-Leader’s Plans
summary_full: President Mohammed Shahabuddin stepped down as speculation swirled over the possible return of his onetime ally Sheikh Hasina, who was ousted as prime minister and fled to India.
